persons.name: Jayabhūpatīndramalladeva
persons.evidence: jayabhūpatīndra malladevasana tutha cuka sa śrī3 revanta sake toraṇa duṃtoyā sāphūla

date.as_written: saṃ 827 āṣāḍha śukla saptami hasta nakṣatra arigha yoga budhavāra

purpose: toraṇa duṃtoyā (record/manual for the donation of a toraṇa to Revanta in Tutha Cuk)
notes: The manuscript is designated as a sāphū related to King Bhūpatīndra Malla of Bhaktapur offering a toraṇa to Revanta at Tutha Cuka.
